brief:
Israeli fighter jets carried out airstrikes on areas in southern Lebanon, Shehab Wire reported, alongside artillery bombardment and machine-gun sweeps targeting towns in the region. The strikes coincided with Israeli occupation forces confirming their continued presence in the area.

The operation reflects ongoing military activity along the Lebanon-Israel border, where Israeli forces have maintained a deployment amid escalating cross-border tensions.

title: Israeli warplanes strike southern Lebanese villages with artillery fire
